d:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s appeal to corporate India to invest and create jobs has given the Congress an opportunity to revive its long-standing criticism of the government’s economic policies.
In this episode of Express Newsroom, we examine why Congress believes issues such as unemployment, weak MSMEs, policy uncertainty and private investment could become central to its political pitch. Is the party now looking to shift the focus back to bread-and-butter issues, and how concerned is the BJP about the political implications ahead of the upcoming elections?
